title: Move remaining Svelte management workflows to the owned API

costar.context: The owner requires a minimal faithful Svelte and API cutover with zero regression.
costar.objective: Remove direct private JMAP calls from actions, account security and bootstrap adapters.
costar.response: Tested main commit with remaining verification stated explicitly.

concerns: Action creation responses are partial results, not persisted records with id and @type; using the generic read contract would reject valid results.
Password changes require slash-delimited field patches; replacing otpAuth clears MFA.
App passwords must return the creation secret once and list every page.
Bootstrap returns no record on configured hosts; only notFound should map to an empty state.
Docker disk has less free space than FoundationDB requires; live verification must not be claimed until resolved.
context: Latest owner clarification drops cross-platform work and prioritizes the smallest faithful owned API cutover.
current_state: At bb3ad50, generic admin CRUD uses /api/v1/registry, but three adapters still call private x: methods over JMAP.
target_design: The existing API carries these workflows with validated requests and responses, preserving the Svelte screens and current permissions.
changes: Add operation-specific action-result and password-patch handling to the existing registry client.
Move actions, account security and bootstrap adapters onto that client.
Test real response shapes, MFA patch preservation, one-time secrets, pagination, refusals and session continuity.
boundaries: Standard mail protocols and engine implementation remain intact; this change does not claim engine independence.
Preserve existing screens, data and configuration; no release tag or PR.
Do not retire affected workflows without live equivalence evidence.

verification.name: Whole web regression suite
verification.proves: All existing UI checks, generated contracts, tests, browser flows and build remain valid.

verification.name: Live management parity
verification.command: npm run test:contract-live; npm run test:live; python deploy/local/verify_account.py
verification.proves: Candidate adapters preserve real engine behavior and user journeys, compared with existing private operations using synthetic data.
verification.expected: Affected live workflows and existing suites pass; unavailable checks remain unverified.

verification.name: Operating records
verification.proves: The repository operating records remain valid.
